cards.scope: Complete the XLM parity and threat model
cards.evidenceText: Design decision: use one Stellar account per vault, funded and activated by the user's wallet through CreateAccount. Connected-wallet support remains to verify. XRC source can represent XLM/USD; its generic defaults include received-rate floor 3 and freshness up to 120 seconds, but live XLM source quorum and quote are unverified. The read-only IC connector refused the backend because its service-discoverability manifest is missing; the direct XRC sample is a paid update and was not called. Direct endpoint probes could not run under the local DNS sandbox. Mara Junior's first read-only audit and second Sonnet/Haiku design review are complete; open design, implementation, and release work remains. A 2-of-3 independent provider-result quorum is the Horizon target; provider selection remains unresolved and source helpers have no provider wiring. SDF public Horizon, Tatum authenticated Horizon, and Blockdaemon authenticated Horizon are research candidates; Ankr is a fourth candidate. None is validated or provisioned. Separately, a read-only mainnet XRP config check on 2026-10-27 returned Active, a $30,000 debt ceiling (3,000,000,000,000 e8s), and an explicit Linear rate curve. Decoded live values are a 128% borrow threshold, 117% liquidation ratio, 7.5% liquidation bonus, 0.2% borrowing fee, 1.5% base APR, and 132.266666666666666624% recovery target. Those differ from the XRP source constructor's $2,500 ceiling and 150%/133%/12% parameters; do not present constructor values as current live parity. XRP evidence only; no XLM registration, deployment, or live config is proved.

cards.scope: Build the Stellar rail and independent address and transaction vectors
cards.evidenceText: Commits 756ff1a5 and eb379f9c add Stellar network-bound provider configuration and transaction-status transport/transform registration. The transport exposes typed HTTP 200/404 evidence from three providers, preserves `fee_charged` on 200 and normalized not-found problem evidence on 404. Scoped rustfmt/diff check passed, but no Cargo/dfx tests or live provider calls have run. The 1,307-line parser/quorum/replacement policy still has 39 unrun tests. Provider independence and evidence freshness remain unresolved; these changes do not establish live settlement. No live Horizon outcall, deposit credit, registration, deployment, or collateral admission is proved.

cards.scope: Add stable state and an XLM launch guard
cards.evidenceText: Commits 4d52680b and 7658ed2f add dormant pure credit/key state, multi-operation receipt parsing, and permanent custody attribution/status. Commit 52730be0 adds the unregistered transaction-status parser/quorum/replacement policy; its 39 tests remain unrun. Commits 756ff1a5 and eb379f9c add network-bound provider config and typed 200/404 transport/transform source, but no Cargo/dfx tests or live provider calls have run. Claim/intent/receipt/status state remains dormant and creates no live credit. Generated Candid and frontend declarations remain stale after the key setter change. Config remains Frozen; XLM is not registered, deployed, or admitted as collateral.

cards.scope: Implement verified XLM deposits and borrowing
cards.evidenceText: Status transport now supplies typed 200/404 evidence from three network-bound providers and preserves `fee_charged` and normalized 404 not-found evidence in source. No Cargo/dfx test or live call has verified it. Provider independence and evidence freshness remain unresolved. WP3 remains blocked: there is no live XLM deposit/borrow endpoint or credit/receipt/tombstone lifecycle. Full deposit credit, current reserve/oracle checks, and testnet/frontend integration remain open. No live provider/oracle proof, XLM admission, or deployment is proved.

cards.scope: Implement XLM claims, exits, and liquidation handling
cards.evidenceText: Fail-closed payout and route/status/frontend guards remain source-only. The transaction-status policy has 39 unrun tests; typed 200/404 transport now preserves fee and not-found evidence in source but is not Cargo/dfx-tested or live-verified. Provider independence and evidence freshness remain unresolved. No live claim settlement/payout lifecycle exists, so WP4 stays blocked. A live XRP post-sign status race is a separate claim-reuse caution, not an XLM-specific required gate. Reserve/oracle checks, testnet, frontend, and release work remain open. Frozen config prevents XLM admission.

cards.scope: Integrate Candid, user flows, and operator monitoring
cards.evidenceText: Earlier Candid regeneration and compatibility checks passed. Source-only key setter/getter changes the Candid interface; generated `.did` and frontend declarations remain stale pending canonical regeneration. Multi-operation receipt/status and frontend guard changes have not been compiled. Full XLM frontend integration and supported deposit/withdrawal/claim flows remain open.

cards.scope: Validate the rail with tests, independent review, and Stellar testnet evidence
cards.evidenceText: Earlier focused `chains::stellar` Cargo tests passed 34/34 before these commits. Commit 52730be0 adds the transaction-status parser/quorum/replacement policy with 39 unrun tests. Commits 756ff1a5 and eb379f9c add network-bound provider config and typed 200/404 transport; scoped rustfmt/diff check passed, but Cargo/dfx tests and live provider calls have not run. `fee_charged` and normalized not-found problem evidence are preserved in source. Remaining blockers are provider independence, evidence freshness, full deposit credit and claim settlement, current oracle/reserve checks, frontend/testnet, and release. The live XRP post-sign status race is a separate reuse caution, not an XLM gate. WP3/WP4 remain blocked; no live provider/oracle proof, admission, or deployment.

cards.scope: Prepare deployment, configuration, and activation evidence
cards.evidenceText: Mara Junior's first read-only audit and second Sonnet/Haiku design review are complete; a separate transaction-status review file is underway. A provider network-binding agent is also working. Broader release work remains open: current reserve freshness/oracle validation, deposit and claim lifecycles, testnet/frontend integration, exact-head validation, artifact review, and rollback/monitoring. Release is blocked. The live XRP post-sign status race remains a separate XRP reuse caution, not a required XLM gate. No live provider/oracle proof, deployment, or activation is proved.
